The overall view retains all supplied Annex values. Separate views use the feeding topic supported by the extracted question, with the definition used to clarify abbreviated questions. General IYCF, message-only and mixed measures remain in the overall view. Breastfeeding-specific advice, education and support are included and labelled.

All 113 countries / territories are available here, including small islands.

Dataset overview

These charts count countries with records for each indicator across all years. The overall category contains the separate indicators and other supplied measures; these counts must not be added together. Countries can also occur in several source or population categories. Distinct-record totals exclude the exact duplicate.
